final: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT mt.Name, t.UnitPrice, CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds as bytes_per_ms FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804), media_stats AS (SELECT Name, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM filtered_data GROUP BY Name), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as global_avg_bytes_per_ms FROM filtered_data) SELECT ms.Name, ms.avg_unit_price, ms.avg_bytes_per_ms, CASE WHEN ga.global_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ms.avg_bytes_per_ms / ga.global_avg_bytes_per_ms END as relative_ratio FROM media_stats ms CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE ga.global_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ms.Name
